h1: River City Hotel Pattani — a riverside hotel with a pool made for families in Pattani
intro: If you're coming to Pattani as a family or a group and want a stay with a pool for the kids and a restaurant on-site, River City Hotel Pattani is a name that comes up for many travellers. It's a 3-star midrange hotel that opened in 2017, sitting on the Pattani River along Charoen Pradit Road on the side heading towards Prince of Songkla University. It has around 70 rooms, many with balconies looking over the river, an outdoor swimming pool, the Maenam riverside restaurant serving Southern Thai and seafood with halal options, generous parking and free Wi-Fi. Standard rooms start from around ฿1,100/night.

body.html: River City Hotel Pattani has been open since 2017 as a midrange hotel geared towards families, seminar groups and travellers who want a riverside setting. The building sits on Charoen Pradit Road beside the Pattani River, on the side that runs towards the Rusamilae area and Prince of Songkla University, Pattani campus. It's about a 7–10 minute drive to the Anoru old town and the central markets — not in the middle of the walkable district, but the riverside spot is quiet and easy, with quick access to the university, which suits people arriving with their own car.

There are around 70 rooms, from Standard up to Suites and river-view rooms. A point guests often raise is that the rooms are fairly spacious and many come with a private balcony over the river. Inside you get air-conditioning, a fridge/mini-bar, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom. Sitting on the balcony watching the water in the evening is an atmosphere many reviews say is worth the price. Some rooms lean to an older, more classic style than the city's newer openings, but overall they are clean and roomier than you might expect for the rate.
"Spacious room with a river-view balcony, a pool the kids could swim in, and staff who were really helpful with parking. The riverside restaurant was tasty and halal — great value for a family stay."

What sets River City apart from the smaller stays in town is the range of facilities. There's an outdoor swimming pool and the Maenam riverside restaurant serving Chinese, Southern Thai and seafood with halal options — dishes like roast duck, sour curry with sea bass and crab curry with cha-om. On top of that there's a fitness room, a bar/coffee shop, a karaoke room and large banquet/seminar halls, which make it a popular choice for parties and conferences in the province. Parking is generous and staffed, something drivers really appreciate.

On food and service, the riverside restaurant is a highlight that earns praise, especially for an easy evening meal by the water with a full set of halal options. Most staff are praised for being friendly and helpful. That said, breakfast isn't included in every package, so check when you book — and if it isn't, there are plenty of eateries along Charoen Pradit Road and in town to choose from.

To be honest, River City is not a brand-new hotel and it isn't in the heart of the walkable district. The pool is on the small side — some reviews say it's better for kids to splash in than for serious laps — and parts of the hotel show an older style that has seen a fair bit of use. The riverside location on the Rusamilae side means you'll drive into town for the markets or the shrine. But if you're travelling as a family or group, have a car and want a spacious room with a pool and restaurant all in one place, those trade-offs buy you a lot of convenience.

With a score of around 8.1 from real guests, River City Hotel Pattani positions itself as a midrange hotel that fits families, seminar groups and self-drivers who want a riverside stay with a pool at a reasonable price. If your trip is about comfort, bringing the kids, or hosting a party or meeting, this is a standout in its price bracket in Pattani.

honestSummary: River City Hotel Pattani is the best-fitting riverside hotel with a pool for families and self-driving groups — spacious rooms, river-view balconies, a halal riverside restaurant and generous parking. The trade-off is that it isn't in the heart of the walkable district and some corners feel dated, but if your trip is about convenience and you have a car, it's a standout in its price bracket.

tips.title: Ask for a river-view room with a balcony
tips.body: Many rooms have a private balcony over the Pattani River. Request a river view when you book — it's a lovely spot for an evening coffee by the water.

tips.title: Try the Maenam riverside restaurant
tips.body: The on-site restaurant serves Southern Thai, Chinese and seafood with halal options like sour curry with sea bass and crab curry with cha-om — great for dinner by the river.

tips.title: Take the kids to the pool in the evening
tips.body: The outdoor pool is small but fine for kids to splash in. Late afternoon, when the sun is off it, is the most comfortable time.

tips.title: Check whether breakfast is included
tips.body: Breakfast isn't included in every package. If it isn't, there are plenty of eateries along Charoen Pradit Road and in town to choose from.

faq.q: Where is River City Hotel Pattani and what's nearby?
faq.a: River City Hotel Pattani is at 2/99 Moo 1, Charoen Pradit Road, Rusamilae, Mueang Pattani, on the Pattani River. It's about an 8-minute drive to the Anoru old town and markets, and around 7 minutes to Prince of Songkla University, Pattani. It's not in the walkable district, so it suits travellers arriving by car.

faq.q: How much does River City Hotel Pattani cost and what room types are there?
faq.a: Standard rooms start from around ฿1,100/night. Options run from Standard and the river-view Superior to Deluxe and the Suite at around ฿1,900. Prices vary by date and platform, so compare a few sites before booking.

faq.q: Does River City Hotel Pattani have a pool and a restaurant?
faq.a: Yes to both. There's an outdoor swimming pool — small but fine for kids — and the Maenam riverside restaurant serving Chinese, Southern Thai and seafood with halal options. There's also a fitness room, a bar, a karaoke room and banquet/seminar halls.

faq.q: Who is River City Hotel Pattani best for?
faq.a: It suits families, seminar groups and self-drivers who want a spacious riverside room with a pool and restaurant in one place. Parking is generous and PSU Pattani is a short drive. If you want to explore the old town on foot without a car, a boutique in the Anoru area may suit better.

faq.q: Does River City Hotel Pattani have river-view rooms and is breakfast included?
faq.a: Yes, there are Superior river-view rooms with a private balcony over the Pattani River — request one when you book. Breakfast isn't included in every package, so check when booking; if it isn't, there are eateries along Charoen Pradit Road and in town.
